fun plan() {
  val registry = readRepoFile(path="/tmp/gh-aw/agent/plan-tools.md")
  val plan = compute(inputs=listOf(registry), purpose="Build the allowed workflow manifest from the registry before task work.")
  val taskContext = readRepoFile(path="/tmp/gh-aw/task-context.json")
  val evidence = compute(inputs=listOf(plan, taskContext), purpose="Echo gather verdict exactly and grade each gather divergence by index; no divergences means no graded findings.")
  writeFile(path="/tmp/gh-aw/evidence.json", content=evidence)
  publish(channel="safeoutputs.noop", body="No action needed: mm-compliance judge evidence written with no gather divergences to grade.")
}
